notes: Scheme labels are extracted only where the source plainly states one. A null label with a description means the source explained why no base scheme is published; nothing is inferred.

defense.description: Ioane’s stated identity is smart, fast, physical, with scheme fitted to personnel rather than a fixed doctrine. 2026 depth-chart structure (JACK / nickel / nose) is consistent with flexible odd/hybrid fronts; an exclusive official “base defense” label remains Not listed.
defense.label: nickel

offense.description: First-year OC Brett Bartolone installs an Air Raid–inspired, explosivity-first passing attack after Choate’s prior run-first years; Choate has publicly framed a shift toward roughly balanced (≈50/50) run-pass while retaining physical run identity (Nevada Sports Net).
offense.label: Air Raid-inspired
